name: cleanroom_enzgfm_directional_router_temporal_protein_cold_v1
design_evidence: Only train-only inner-fold Gate-A results were read before this freeze; the running nested-v2 job was explicitly stopped before final fit/evaluator so temporal_post2020_protein_cold test_pairs remained unread by the EnzGFM representation family.
factorial_grid: all 3 protein representations x both frozen reaction representations

inner_selection.split: same strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint stable hash folds used by nested-v2
inner_selection.selection: per direction independently: highest mean fold-wise five-metric percentile; then highest worst-fold percentile; then lower variability; deterministic candidate-name tie break

final_fit: After directional selection, reinitialize and train one R2E expert and one E2R expert on all target-cell train_pairs with the same recipe; if both select the same feature pair, one deterministic final fit may be shared.

evaluation.candidate_pool: exact full registered 185,918 proteins and 11,081 reactions

post_reveal_policy: Do not alter the candidate grid, direction metrics, selector, training recipe, feature construction, or routing rule from the temporal outer result.
